rationale: The agent found that all 59 test proteins also appear in training, so every test pair shares a protein with training. It explained that identity features let the model memorize per-protein 'stickiness' rather than learn pair biology, refused to report the inflated 0.82–0.85 AUROC, and proposed a protein-disjoint re-split. It did not compute the no-feature per-protein baseline, but the 59/59 overlap figure matches the key's ~100% overlap item.
